title: SI No 60 of 2014 - A Proclamation for the Computer Misuse and Cybercrime Act, 2014
text:
VIRGIN ISLANDS
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT 2014 NO. 60
COMPUTER MISUSE AND CYBERCRIME ACT, 2014
(No. 9 of 2014)
A PROCLAMATION
BY THE GVOERNOR UNDER SECTION 1 OF THE COMPUTER MISUSE AND
CYBERCRIME ACT, 2014 DECLARING THE DATE ON WHICH THE SAID ACT
SHALL COME INTO FORCE
(Sgd.) Boyd McCleary, CMG, CVO,
Governor.
[Gazetted 14th August, 2014]
WHEREAS it is provided by section 1 of the Computer Misuse and Cybercrime Act,
2014 (No. 9 of 2014) that the said Act shall come into force on such date as the Governor
may, by Proclamation published in the Gazette, appoint;
NOW THEREFORE, by the virtue and in exercise of the powers vested in me, I do
hereby proclaim that the said Computer Misuse and Cybercrime Act, 2014 shall come into
force on the 1st day of September, 2014.
AND all Her Majesty’s loving subjects are hereby required to take note hereof and
govern themselves accordingly.
GIVEN under my hand and the
Public Seal of the Virgin Islands at the
Governor’s Office in Tortola in the
Virgin Islands this 1st day of August,
2014 and in the sixty-third year of Her
Majesty’s reign.
GOD SAVE THE QUEEN!
